summary: The parent restricts steiner_tree to default u32 graph indices, preventing calls with other index types. The fix introduces Ix: IndexType across the input graph, terminals, and returned graph. A verbatim signature reversal is available, but no detecting upstream test was found: all existing calls use default indices. The modified test::example_kous_paper changes only edge weights from i32 to usize, not indices. Leave this candidate blocked for lack of a detecting test; no builds or tests were run.
